plan.title: Cancel Adding Line Item in Saved Draft

steps.note: Navigate to the events list so the saved draft can be opened.
Confirm the events list rendered before navigating to Drafts.
Open the Drafts tab where the saved eRFX draft should appear.
Open the first saved draft; drafts reopen on their create screen.
Establish the stated starting condition that the draft has one line item.
Open the Manage Line Items window.

args.label: Search and add line items using product name

steps.note: Search for the product the case attempts to add.
Select the searched product from the product results.
Enter the requested quantity for the unsaved line item.
Enter the requested price for the unsaved line item.
Cancel the Manage Line Items operation so the entered line item should be discarded.
Verify that cancellation left the draft at its original one-line-item count, proving no new item was added.
